explication: Nagram XF is an Android Telegram client fork, combining Telegram’s messaging application with additions from related clients. The principal user journey is app launch into the client UI, followed by messaging actions handled by account and message services, persisted locally and exchanged over Telegram’s network; the sampled material does not expose enough call sites to verify that full sequence. Distinct documented or indexed branches include localization, search, bookmarks, group-call messaging, and Elyx plugins. Dashed links mark workflow relationships not verified in the excerpts.
